correctness.rationale: The claim is finite. The published transition diagram was independently transcribed. Exact BFS over image subsets finds the first singleton at lengths \(58\) and \(56\). Exact integer expansion verifies the displayed factorizations and total \(2^{30}3^6\).

value.rationale: The \(n=9\) case is the endpoint of the complete exhaustive census in the defining paper, so it is a natural historical boundary rather than an arbitrary small slice. The factorized enumerators refine reset threshold to the complete letter-use distribution of every optimal reset word and expose a non-obvious equality of \(782{,}757{,}789{,}696\) optimal words for two colorings with different thresholds and different composition laws. This is a reusable exact benchmark for shortest-word algorithms and structural studies of slowly synchronizing automata.
